inline.afterHeadingEn: ## Reading the Full Chart vs Just Her Sun Sign
inline.altEn: Side-by-side comparison of the sun-sign approach and the full-chart approach to reading Bella Hadid's placements

linesEn: Reduces to one archetype — fast and shareable
Hands you one adjective and a meme
Example: she is Libra, so she is charming and balanced
Layers Sun, Moon, rising, and Scorpio cluster together
Captures contradiction instead of flattening it
Richer but slower and harder to summarize
Example: Libra image over a Scorpio interior — charm and guardedness are both real

inline.titleEn: Five Steps to Read the Chart as Archetype

items.subEn: Look for the diplomacy-and-aesthetics theme: harmony, image, and relationship as a core lens
Read the cluster of Scorpio placements as intensity held privately rather than performed
Notice how public poise and guarded depth describe one person, not a puzzle to solve

items.nameEn: Treat the rising sign as provisional

items.nameEn: Map aspects as tension, not fate
